_about: Everything the coach can say. Each key is a cue id; each entry has one or more phrasings. Audio clips are named <id>_<index> (numbers: n_<count>). tools/make_voice.py reads this file to generate natural-voice clips; the app falls back to the browser's voice for any clip that's missing.

fast: Two seconds on the way down
half: That one didn't count. All the way down
position: Turn side on, whole body in view
Step back, I need to see all of you
ready: Get into your plank when you're ready
sq_shallow: Get your hips down to knee height
sq_fast: Two seconds on the way down
sq_half: That one didn't count. Sit lower
sq_ready: Stand tall, side on, when you're ready
sq_position: Turn side on, head to feet in view
Step back, I need to see your feet
br_low: Push through your heels, hips up
br_hold: Hold the squeeze at the top
br_half: That one didn't count. Hips all the way up
br_ready: Lie on your back, side on, knees bent
br_position: Turn side on, shoulders to feet in view
Move the camera back, I need to see your feet
rd_squat: Push your hips back, not down
Soft knees, send your hips back
rd_drift: Keep the weights close to your legs
rd_fast: Two seconds on the way down
rd_half: That one didn't count. Hips further back
rd_ready: Stand tall, side on, weights at your thighs
rd_position: Turn side on, head to feet in view
Step back, I need to see your feet
